errors.evidence: The highest peak of the line is not located exactly at x = 0.0, but slightly to the right of it, at approximately x=0.05. The use of the word 'exactly' makes this a significant error.
The secondary peak is located at x = 0.2, directly on the tick mark, not at x = 0.18.

The description of the decline after the secondary peak omits a data point. The line first drops from the peak at x=0.2 to a point around (x=0.3, y=9000), and then drops again to the low point near x=0.35. The description incorrectly portrays this as a single steep decline.
The data point after the main peak is located at approximately x=0.1. The value x=0.09 is overly specific and slightly incorrect.
The low point after the secondary peak is located closer to x=0.35 than x=0.36.
